text:
Ashwin: Quick heads-up — we need to reshuffle RFC review slots for Tuesday. @Clare told me she's traveling and can't make the 14:00 slot. Can someone swap or cover?
Clare: Sorry, unexpected travel. I can do a recorded walk-through but can't attend live at 14:00. Apologies for the late notice. :sweat_smile:
Nick: I can pick up Clare's 14:00 slot if that helps, but I'd prefer moving it to 16:00 — I have two reviews back-to-back earlier. Is that ok for authors?
Olivia: I can cover the pre-read readout and do a 5min TL;DR at the top if the author uploads slides by EOD. Also +1 to keeping slots contiguous so reviewers don't hop between Zoom links.
Ashwin: Thanks. Proposed anchor/order (draft):
```
15:00 — perf-regression-rfc (author: Priya) — 20m
15:30 — infra-gating-rfc (author: Ashwin) — 15m
16:00 — privacy-keys-rfc (was Clare) — 20m (Nick to review)
```
Ashwin: If authors can't do 16:00, we can swap the infra slot later. Need confirmations by EOD so I can update the calendar.
Nick: I confirm 16:00 works for me to review Clare's RFC. I'll skim pre-read now and post comments.
Clare: Uploaded slides and short preread notes here: https://redwood-internal/docs/rfcs/privacy-keys/pre-read — sorry again, can do async Q&A in thread if needed.
Olivia: Reading now. Couple of things I'd flag for the author: dataflow diagram missing an explicit step for KMS handshake. I'll comment inline.
Ashwin: Good catch — whoever's reviewing, please add an example prompt in the back-half so we can validate edge cases.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "RFC Review — Tue" moved: 14:00->15:00, 16:00 slot added. Organizer: Ashwin.
Nick: Heads-up for chairs: can we keep a 5min buffer between 15:30 and 16:00 to allow quick follow-ups? Otherwise reviewers will run late.
Ashwin: Yep — will add 5min padding and a note in the invite: "Please post follow-up comments to the thread; we may triage asynchronously if we run tight."
Olivia: I'll collect the TL;DRs and make a single thread summary after the meeting for folks on PTO.
Ashwin: Thanks everyone — final ask: if you're assigned to review, post a one-line ack here ("I got this") by 18:00 so we have coverage.
Nick: I got this.
Olivia: I got this (pre-read done).
Clare: Thanks — I can do async QA, and I'll watch the recording.
Ashwin: Calendar updated and agenda pinned in the event. Closing the loop. :thumbsup:
